decision_rule: Scope: scope-file 'lines' from the 24th claim_id (p-psi-darien-wi:opening_line) to the end, 22 claims. A line is confirmed only if every fact is on a stated evidence row of that plant (or the plants.csv field it cites), attributed to the site, correctly dated (own-board JSON-LD datePosted or raw PostedDate; UKG board dates written as 'listed'), still current today (boards and postings re-read 2026-11-17), with no plan written as progress and no company-level fact written as the site's; opening lines newest fact first, no pitch, ending with a second-person 'you' question; bottleneck guesses say 'likely' or 'possibly'. Corrected otherwise. 'unknown' values with no supporting fact to check are confirmed.
error_rate_note: 6/21 = 28.6% over the 21 evidence rows in scope (scope file lists 22 claim_ids; p-taylor-power-richland-ms:bottleneck_guess has no evidence row, plants.csv holds 'unknown', so it is not a row here: see field_drift_notes).
